prompt:
Research the official rate limits of the public GitHub REST API for unauthenticated and authenticated requests. Cite the GitHub documentation page and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
I found official GitHub documentation confirming the current primary REST API rate limits:

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "You can make unauthenticated requests if you are only fetching public data, but unauthenticated requests are associated with your IP address, not with a user or application." | CLAIM: Unauthenticated public REST API requests are rate-limited by the requesting IP address.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "The primary rate limit for unauthenticated requests is 60 requests per hour." | CLAIM: Unauthenticated GitHub REST API requests are limited to 60 requests per hour.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "Primary rate limits for authenticated users are associated with the authenticated user." | CLAIM: Authenticated primary rate limits apply to the authenticated user rather than the client IP address.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "You can use a `GITHUB_TOKEN` to authenticate requests for GitHub Actions workflows. For more information, see \"[Automatic token authentication](/actions/security-for-github-actions/security-guides/automatic-token-authentication).\"" | CLAIM: GitHub documents separate authenticated REST API limits for requests made with the GitHub Actions `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "The primary rate limit for authenticated users is 5,000 requests per hour." | CLAIM: Standard authenticated user requests are limited to 5,000 requests per hour.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "When using `GITHUB_TOKEN`, the rate limit is 1,000 requests per hour per repository." | CLAIM: GitHub Actions requests authenticated with `GITHUB_TOKEN` are limited to 1,000 requests per hour per repository.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "If you are using a `GITHUB_TOKEN` from an Enterprise Cloud organization, the rate limit is 15,000 requests per hour per repository." | CLAIM: A `GITHUB_TOKEN` from an Enterprise Cloud organization has a higher limit of 15,000 requests per hour per repository.
